entries.reason: Every URL the program parses is a constant in PARSE-PARA / LENGTH-PARA (each has a path) and the only scenario input is the mode letter; the parsed PATH keeps its leading '/' (register X36, ASSUMED: IBM does not say; a URL with no path is REFUSED by the model), so 'IF WS-PATH(1:1) = '/'' is false only for a URL the program never holds.

QUERYSTRING is returned without its question mark (register X36, ASSUMED, as IBM's WEB CONVERSE takes it), and the URLs are the program's constants, so the first byte of WS-QRY is never '?' on a successful parse: the true arm ('MOVE WS-QRY(2:10)') runs for no input.
